title: Structure-module etale sum extension with scheme-chart germ coordinates
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $j:Z\to X$ be a representable etale morphism of algebraic spaces with their small etale structure sheaves and module categories [def-trf-algebraic-space], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. For an etale scheme chart $W\to X$, its lift labels are the sections $a\in Z(W)$ mapping to the chart section in $X(W)$; Yoneda identifies them with the maps $W\to Z$ over $X$. A lift is etale and determines a chart $(W,a)$ of $Z$. Put $P_jM(W)=\bigoplus_a M(W,a)$. Restriction along $r:V\to W$ sends the $a$-summand by the restriction of $M$ into the $ar$-summand; it is semilinear, preserves identities and composition, including when labels merge. Morphisms of $M$ act on their respective summands and commute with these restrictions. Define $j_!M$ by module sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] of this explicit presheaf, and its maps by sheafification of these summandwise maps; additive sheafification in the original section universe is supplied by [def-sfb-space-comm-algebra-sheaf]. Its section generator is a direct-sum injection followed by the sheafification unit. Use the existing geometric ring and module stalks and structural ring maps [def-sfb-space-geometric-stalk-models]. For a geometric point $x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ and every pointed etale scheme chart $(W,w)$ in [def-sfb-space-pointed-etale-abelian-stalk], the germ of a section is the unique additive map agreeing with every pointed affine refinement cocone. Such maps exist by cofinality of the fixed affine basis. Evaluate a lift $a$ at $w$ to get the lift $aw$ and the same pointed chart of $Z$. For each geometric lift $z$ over $x$, use the actual structural map $\mathcal O_{X,x}\to\mathcal O_{Z,z}$, transporting its target-point equality explicitly, and regard $M_z$ as a module over $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ by restriction of scalars through this map.
